_note: How an imported product's Hebrew title maps to our tags: team, league, season, style, player, plus plain search-keyword tags in English and Arabic. Read by scripts/catalog/classify.mjs. Every team, league, style and player has he/en/ar names; they match catalog/taxonomy.json (classify.mjs warns on a mismatch). 'match' lists Hebrew spellings as they appear in titles.

tag_conventions.season: season:YYYY-YY, football only, read from the title (26/27 -> season:2026-27)
tag_conventions.player: player:<slug>, plus the player's Hebrew name as a plain tag (for Hebrew site search)
tag_conventions.keywords: plain tags for site search: team, league, player, product-type, audience and style words in English (lowercase) and Arabic. Imported products have no EN/AR translations, and Shopify's storefront search matches product tags. Shopify treats two tags with the same handle as one tag ("all star" = "all-star", "קפוצ'ון" = "קפוצון") and keeps only one, so each list holds one spelling per handle, and classify.mjs compares tags the same way.

rules.team: The longest team name ('match') found in the title, among teams of the product's sport. National teams match as 'נבחרת <country>'. Falls back to the product's existing team: tag (through team_tag_aliases for old slugs).
rules.league: From the team. Every basketball product must end with a league (nba, wnba, ncaa, national-teams) or style:special; anything else is reported as unclassified.
rules.season: Football titles only: 26/27 -> season:2026-27, 12/13 -> season:2012-13. A bare year (2026) is not a season.
rules.style: Title keywords (styles.*.match); a team's own styles (collabs are special, SuperSonics are retro); and style:retro when the title's season starts before retro_before_season.
rules.player: A player named in the title wins. Otherwise basketball titles with 'מספר N' use player_numbers (high-confidence team + number pairs only). For Mitchell & Ness retro jerseys the jock tag (season + name) must agree; disagreements go to overrides.
rules.audience: Kept when present. Missing: 'לילדים' -> kids, 'לנשים' -> women, otherwise adult.
rules.overrides: Per-handle corrections checked against the product photos. 'team': null or 'player': null means none (and removes an existing tag). 'styles' are added to the ones found in the title.
